title: IR-Runbook-SMB-Lateral-Movement
summary: Original short-response guidance for suspicious SMB lateral movement and rare outbound peers.
content:
## 1.1 [Immediate] Restrict suspicious SMB connections
Block confirmed malicious external peers and limit SMB access to approved internal management paths. Isolate a host only when the surrounding evidence indicates compromise.

## 2.1 [Investigate] Trace SMB sessions and authentication
Correlate firewall flow records, SMB share access, logon events, source and destination addresses, and account activity to identify the initiating host and accessed shares.

## 3.1 [Recover] Revoke exposed access and restore least privilege
Disable or rotate confirmed compromised accounts, remove unauthorized shares or scheduled access, and restore SMB rules to the approved baseline.
